explication: Wholphin is an Android TV client for Jellyfin. The main user journey is connecting a server and profile, browsing a configurable home or library, opening media details, and playing media through ExoPlayer or MPV. The graph also preserves major documented branches for search, Seerr discovery, Live TV/DVR, music, and screensavers. Source excerpts are limited, so several UI and playback relationships are documented capabilities rather than inspected call paths; those links are marked dashed.
